group_notes.Heroes & banners: The big visual openers and full-width statement bands.
group_notes.Cards, grids & showcases: The card-based layouts that make up most listing and hub pages.
group_notes.Product page modules: The modules that assemble a product page. Most are data-driven: the content lives on the product (metafields/metaobjects), and the module renders whatever the current product carries – the same template serves all 116 products.
group_notes.Artists & people: The artist profile page kit. All data-driven from artist page metafields.
group_notes.Data-driven utilities: Modules that render structured store data – events, retailers, documents, forms.
group_notes.Internal / not in use: Kept in the theme but not part of any live page.

entries.purpose: The standard page/collection opener: a full-width image with an invisible (screen-reader-only) title. On collections it can pull the collection's own image and description automatically.
The bigger editorial hero with visible eyebrow, heading, body copy and up to two buttons – used on the vertical gateways and landing pages.
The homepage hero: autoplay slides, each with its own image, copy and link.

The full-width parallax image band with a quote/statement over it – the signature break between page sections. Settings-driven on most pages; on product pages it can pull the quote from product metafields.
The orange promo band ("Clever engineering" and siblings): eyebrow chip, big two-line heading, body and buttons, with alignment and show/hide toggles per element.
The "up next" footer band that walks visitors to the next page in a journey – pick the target page or set a custom title/link.

The general prose module: rich-text column with optional eyebrow/heading/accent and buttons, in several layouts. When you need to add plain written content to a designed page, this is usually the module to reach for.
A standalone heading band (eyebrow + heading + accent word + optional body and CTA) used to introduce a following section.
The breadcrumb trail. Automatic on products/collections; on pages the trail is composed from its crumb blocks.
Accordion FAQ list – each question/answer is a block. On tool resource pages the FAQ content can come from metafields instead.
The three-door chooser (e.g. Woodworking / Masonry / Landscaping) that routes visitors into the right vertical – three fixed card blocks.
The general-purpose card grid: each card is a block with image, eyebrow, title, copy and link; supports video cards, column count and an optional section header. Most hub pages are built from these.
The homepage-style mixed-size tile mosaic (featured story + artist + event tiles), each tile configured in settings.

The merchandising showcase used on vertical and landing pages – switches between card styles (applications, projects, accessories) with blocks per tile; some variants pull copy from collection metafields.
The alternating image/copy story banner ("Story banner") – one or more story blocks, each an image + eyebrow + heading + body + button, flippable left/right.
The community projects grid – renders project metaobjects with optional filter chips and video lightboxes; content comes from Settings → Custom data → projects, not from the module.
Product-page variant of the projects grid: shows the projects referenced by the current product's related-projects metafield.
The Inspiration hub's navigation cards – one card block per destination (Artists, Projects, Guides, Competitions…).
A single large guide/article promo card with per-market link overrides (different guide per country if needed).
Latest-from-the-blog strip: picks a blog, how many articles, optional featured-first layout – the articles themselves come from the News blog automatically.
Poster-image video player that opens a YouTube/Vimeo embed – used for the big feature videos on landing pages.
Simple autoplay image carousel with heading and copy – each image is a slide block.
The product feature carousel (product imagery over a coloured/radial background) – each slide is a block pointing at a product.
Customer quotes slider with star rating – quotes come from product testimonial metafields, headings from settings.

The buy box: gallery, price, variant/option pickers, market voltage routing, stock indicator and add-to-cart – plus the bundle configurator on MG1000/ALLSAW. Content comes from the product itself; settings are labels and toggles only.
The What's Included / Specifications / Support tab band – populated from product metafields and linked documents.

The long alternating image/text product story. Content is the Story panel metaobjects on each product (with per-market variants) – edit those under Settings → Custom data, not here (Manual, Blind Spots → Metafields).
"The clever bits" feature callouts on product pages – driven by each product's Clever Bit metaobjects (with market/vertical variants).
"Artists using this tool" cards – renders the artist pages referenced by the product's related-artists metafield.
The product overview video band – video and poster come from product metafields.
Accessory listing hub grouped by category, with compatibility links – used on the accessories overview.
Blade ↔ tool compatibility table driven by the compatible-with metafield.
Related-accessories test harness for the accessories display – internal QA page module.
Artist page opener: hero image, script-style name treatment and role – pulled from the artist page's metafields.
Artist bio band: portrait, detail shot, bio text and pull-quote, all from artist metafields with settings fallbacks.
"Tools of choice" rail on artist pages – each tool is a block referencing a product.
Techniques list on artist pages – one block per technique.
The company timeline on Our Story – each milestone (year, copy, image) is a block.
Renders a designed story layout (the same block system as the story articles) on a page instead of a blog post. No settings – entirely driven by the page's story data. Maintained by Juicebox.
Upcoming events cards – events are metaobjects under Settings → Custom data; the module handles ordering, timezone and empty states.
Find-a-retailer listing grouped by region – retailers are metaobjects under Settings → Custom data.
The technical documents library with filters – documents are metaobjects; the module controls grouping and labels.
The tool resources index – one tile block per tool linking to its resource page.
A single tool's resource page body (manuals, videos, FAQs) – driven by the page's tool-resource metafield data.
The German statutory cancellation (Widerruf) form – submissions post to an automation webhook. Legal plumbing: don't edit without us.
The site footer: newsletter signup, social links, menu columns and legal menu (with a German variant). The column links come from Shopify menus where the matching menu exists.
Internal image-audit surface used during the build – ignore.
A featured-tool spotlight (intro + product + checklist) built during development – currently on no page.
A context-aware split image/copy callout that adapts to the visitor's vertical – currently on no page.
